caseName: Northern Natural Gas Co. v. State Corporation Commission
caseNameFull: Northern Natural Gas Co. v. State Corporation Commission of Kansas
attorneys: W. W. Heard on the motion.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the *932Supreme Court of Kansas. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 370 U. S. 901.) The motion of Mid-Continent Oil & Gas Association for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.

W. W. Heard on the motion. Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
